name: Karamay

queries.query: Karamay official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: No Karamay-specific public parcel API or geometry service was found in the bounded search. An official Karamay government page identified the local Natural Resources Bureau as responsible for unified real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, cadastral surveying, and the natural-resources/real-estate registration information platform.

queries.query: 克拉玛依市 自然资源局 不动产登记 地籍图 GIS
queries.result: Official Karamay government and Xinjiang Natural Resources sources confirmed the local registration custodian and digital registration services. A 2025 official Karamay report states that 323 cadastral subdistricts and 10,200 parcels across four districts had been checked, supplemented, and entered into the database, but it does not publish anonymous parcel geometries or a query schema.

sourceAssessment.officialCustodian: Karamay Municipal Natural Resources Bureau and its district branches; the official bureau description explicitly includes unified real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, cadastral surveying, registration information-platform management, and geospatial-result management.
sourceAssessment.officialOpenServiceLead: Xinjiang Geographic Information Public Service Platform (Tianditu), with a configured Karamay portal at https://xinjiang.tianditu.gov.cn/kelamayi/ and public online map at https://xinjiang.tianditu.gov.cn/map/.
sourceAssessment.registryBasis: Local government source and Xinjiang Natural Resources source directly evidence Karamay's cadastral and real-estate-registration custodian and local data operation; this is registry evidence, not evidence of an open parcel geometry endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Karamay municipal cadastral and real-estate-registration data custody is evidenced by official local-government reporting; public machine-readable parcel coverage is unverified.

blocker: The official Karamay Tianditu portal route timed out during an anonymous bounded GET. No public parcel service URL, layer schema, CRS response, safe native parcel ID, or geometry response was verified.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point is a research locator only. No exact-point hit or miss was used as evidence of citywide parcel absence; urban coverage, service authentication behavior, and native identifier fields remain unverified.
nextStep: Retry the documented Karamay Tianditu portal after service recovery, inspect its current JavaScript/configuration, and query only a small Karamay-area extent for geometry plus a safe native parcel identifier before any adapter qualification.
